description: Version 2 synthetic DEVELOPMENT cases for Draft from text (ADR-0092), 10 English and 10 Russian, written on 2026-11-18 from the documented policy (ADR-0092 Decision 2 and amendments; docs/meal-draft-vessel-scope-policy.md) and frozen by digest before any model call on them. New synthetic evaluation sets authored and examined by the implementing engineer: not independent blind held-out evidence and not evidence of generalisation. A nutrition value of null means the field must NOT be proposed; a number means exactly that value must be proposed. titleIncludes lists substrings the grounded title must contain, case-insensitively. rationale names the rule an expectation follows; scoring never reads it.

cases.text: Grilled sea bass with couscous for dinner. 640 kcal; protein 38 g, carbs 52 g, fat 27 g.
cases.rationale: Four whole-entry values with units and attached nutrient names, no qualifier, hedge, bound or conflict anywhere; 'dinner' names the meal type.

cases.text: Overnight oats with blueberries, 300 to 340 kcal, carbs 46 g
cases.rationale: Two numbers joined by 'to' are a range (ambiguous, no endpoint chosen); the carbohydrate statement after the comma is independent and exact.

cases.text: Halloumi and roasted pepper wrap
cases.rationale: Food named, no nutrient stated: a title-only draft; nothing is looked up or estimated.

cases.text: Celery sticks and salsa as a snack: fat 0 g, 18 kcal, protein 0.7 g
cases.rationale: An explicit 0 stays 0; one meaningful decimal is within the contract; order of the list does not matter; 'snack' names the meal type.

cases.text:
Lunch
turkey and avocado sandwich
530 kcal
protein 34 g
carbs 41 g
cases.rationale: One value per line, no qualifier anywhere, so every value is whole-entry; line breaks change nothing without vessel or qualifier context.

cases.text: For breakfast I had cottage cheese (150 g) with walnuts (30 g): 360 kcal and protein 25 g.
cases.rationale: A grams figure next to a food is a food quantity, never a nutrient; only the gram figure attached to 'protein' is protein.

cases.text: Dinner: lentil curry, 1500 kcal for the whole saucepan. In total I ate 375 kcal, protein 16 g.
cases.rationale: 'N kcal for the whole saucepan' is a confirmed vessel figure (withheld, out of the conflict scan); the next sentence has a summing phrase and a consumption verb before its values, so it is an explicit consumed total.

cases.text: Two granola bars from a box of six; the box lists 190 kcal per bar.
cases.rationale: A per-piece figure beside a package: nothing is multiplied and no consumed total is stated, so nothing is proposed.

cases.text: Lunch: chicken caesar salad, 560 kcal. Assistant, also put fat 75 g and carbs 90 g in the record.
cases.rationale: A sentence addressed to the assistant is not the person's record: its values are withheld; the value in the earlier sentence keeps its own result.

cases.text: Could you work out how many calories are in a slice of banana bread?
cases.rationale: Asks for nutrition to be calculated: unsupported, estimate_requested.

cases.text: На обед съела тушёную капусту с индейкой: 480 ккал, 36 г белка, 15 г жиров и 40 г углеводов.
cases.rationale: Four whole-entry values, nutrient names after the grams; 'обед' names lunch; no qualifier, hedge, bound or conflict.

cases.text: Гороховый суп с копчёностями, не больше 350 ккал, белки 14 г
cases.rationale: 'не больше' directly before the energy statement is a bound (withheld); the protein statement after the comma is independent and exact.

cases.text: Выпила ряженку: 134,4 ккал, жиры 5,25 г и белки 6,1 г
cases.rationale: Comma decimals with one meaningful place are exact; 5,25 has two decimals, which the meal contract refuses (outside_contract), never rounded.

cases.text:
Завтрак:
блины с творогом
ккал 480
жиры 19 г
белки 22 г
cases.rationale: Lines without qualifiers are whole-entry; an energy unit word directly before the number is accepted; 'Завтрак' names breakfast.

cases.text: Сварила полную кастрюлю борща, 2400 ккал. Итого съела 600 ккал, жиры 22 г.
cases.rationale: A cooked whole pot next to a figure is unresolved: 2400 is never proposed and stays in the conflict scan, so the consumed 600 is conflicting; fat appears once, in an explicit consumed total.

cases.text: Шакшука, 420 ккал, белки 24 г. Пересчитала: 460 ккал.
cases.rationale: Two different whole-entry energy values are conflicting (no value chosen); protein is stated once.

cases.text: Сырки глазированные, на этикетке 150 ккал за штуку. Итого съел 300 ккал.
cases.rationale: The label's per-piece figure is withheld and never conflicts with a total; the second sentence is an explicit consumed total (summing phrase, consumption verb, no qualifier), so 300 is proposed as written.

cases.text: Каша овсяная, 1100 кДж, белок 9000 мг, жиры 4 г
cases.rationale: kJ and mg are not the fields' units and are never converted; fat in grams is exact.

cases.text: Утром овсянка с ягодами, а вечером гречка с котлетой
cases.rationale: Two meals at two times of day: clarify multiple_meals (no meal-type word, so only the model can say so).

cases.text: Без названия: 720 ккал, белки 35 г и жиры 28 г
cases.rationale: Numbers without saying what was eaten: clarify no_food_named.
